title: One write-outside-the-checkout guard for every session, which allows notes folders
why: Your ask (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh26MuXHQwVQFmfKrqbe6bgD9): Banchi's guard refused a write to the Claude app's side-session notes folder (~/Library/Application Support/Claude-Work/side-session-notes/), while claude-settings' own rule covers too little.
note: Today claude-settings' worktree-home rule (an agent outside its home tree must stop) covers only isolated subagents, and only writes into the same clone; it skips the top-level session and sessions started in .claude/worktrees/. Banchi's scripts/guard-shell.py clause 2 (tree) covers every session but refuses any path outside the checkout except ~/.claude, /dev and a non-repo temp folder, so it refuses harmless notes folders. claude-settings part green and reviewed: draft PR #749 (dd1ce4fd; Opus round 1, 5 fixes; Sonnet round 2 merge-ready), waits for a batch: guard rule other-checkout refuses any session's write into another checkout of the same clone, allows paths in no checkout, and an owner override lifts it; 3 low notes in docs/debts/notes.md. Checked: claude-settings main 34dc6a9, banchi main dfcde22. Port: the Banchi part is the port. Placed ahead of c107 (triage, Oct 28): the claude-settings part needs no answer and every session hits the gap. claude-settings part done: merged in batch 6 (PR #760, main 599dd58b, Oct 28 05:45 CDT). The Banchi part is c174.
